name: GMK CYL OG Extensions
heroImageAlt: A cluster of four warm-bronze 1.25u modifier caps framing one wide terracotta spacebar, reflecting a bottom-row extensions kit rather than a full set
description: An R4 extensions kit adding bottom-row and spacebar options for existing GMK CYL colorways, kitted through NovelKeys (NA) and Prototypist (UK). Climbed eight straight interest-check weeks on the thock trends tracker before opening a group buy of its own July 15, 2026, running through an August 12 close.
